safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling for the past 1 hour.

Management urgency would remain high given progressive swelling and respiratory symptoms.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a sensation of throat closing.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document a sensation of throat closing can understate a key red-flag symptom of anaphylaxis/airway compromise, potentially lowering perceived severity in subsequent handoffs. This could delay escalation (e.g., epinephrine/urgent airway evaluation) if later clinicians rely on the note.
